- [ ] 🆕 New case / prompt
- [ ] 🐛 Fix (broken link, typo, formatting)
- [ ] 🌐 Translation improvement
- [ ] 📝 Other (describe below)

Paste your prompt here

**Video/media attached?**

## Checklist

- [ ] Any published prompt is copied exactly inside an unlabeled code block; a showcase without a public prompt has no invented prompt block
- [ ] Each video preview links to its playable source; local poster copies preserve the original bytes and source attribution
- [ ] Case follows the existing format in README.md
- [ ] No duplicate of an existing case
- [ ] Original source, creator, publication date, and actual model version are clear
- [ ] No unpublished prompt, result, benchmark, or API behavior has been invented
- [ ] Source media and poster/playback pairing are preserved; any hosting change is explained
- [ ] English and every existing translation reflect the same shared change
- [ ] Original prompts, source URLs, media URLs, case identities, and stable anchors are preserved
- [ ] Changed links, fragment targets, local paths, and desktop/narrow rendering were checked
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes
- [ ] Related repositories are accurately labeled and remain outside this repository's release ownership
